description: Operations & Reliability — SRE / DevOps view. Covers API upstream, latency, errors, conversation quality, MCP/sub-agent ROI. Source: Langfuse ClickHouse · Default: last 7d, 1m refresh. For incident response, jump to “Last 30 Minutes Activity”.

panels.description: Share of GENERATION observations with level=ERROR, excluding user-rejected tool calls ('User rejected tool use'). True API + client path availability, not an SLO.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round((1 - sum(case when level='ERROR'
                       AND coalesce(status_message, '') NOT IN ('User rejected tool use')
                       AND positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(status_message, ''), 'User rejected') = 0
                       then 1 else 0 end) * 1.0
                / nullIf(count(*), 0)) * 100, 2) AS uptime_pct
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

options.content:
**Important**: latency below is measured client-side from Claude Code, so it **includes network time + Anthropic API processing**, with no way to separate the two.

If latency spikes:
- Watch whether **error rate** is also rising → likely an API-side issue.
- Check whether a **specific model** is affected in isolation → likely a model capacity issue.
- Otherwise it's likely a network or client-environment issue.

panels.description: Client-side latency for GENERATION observations: dateDiff(end_time, start_time). Includes Anthropic API time + network. Falls back to NULL when end_time unset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  round(quantile(0.50)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)), 0) AS p50,
  round(quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)), 0) AS p95,
  round(quantile(0.99)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)), 0) AS p99
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
  AND end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: API Latency p50 / p95 / p99

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model,
  round(sum(case when level='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(*), 0), 2) AS error_pct
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)

panels.description: p95 latency by user. When users report slowness, look here first to tell user-specific vs systemic. (limited to top-10 users by request volume)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_users AS (
  SELECT t.user_id
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION'
    AND o.end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
    AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
  GROUP BY t.user_id
  ORDER BY count(*) DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(o.start_time) AS time,
  t.user_id AS user,
  round(quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', o.start_time, o.end_time)), 0) AS p95_ms
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.type='GENERATION'
  AND o.end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND t.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM top_users)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
GROUP BY time, user
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Latency by environment. dev/staging slow vs prod slow = different problems.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  environment AS env,
  round(quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)), 0) AS p95_ms
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
  AND end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND environment IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
GROUP BY time, env
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Tokens per minute / per second. Surfaces rate-limit risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model,
  toFloat64(sum(eff_input + eff_output)) /
    greatest(1, toFloat64(dateDiff('second', min(start_time), max(start_time)))) AS tokens_per_second
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION' AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
GROUP BY time, model
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Hourly API status: UP (green) / DEGRADED (yellow, 1-5% err) / DOWN (red, >5% err). The go-to view for SRE incident retrospectives.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(start_time) AS time,
  'API Status' AS metric,
  multiIf(
    sum(case when level='ERROR' AND status_message NOT LIKE '%User rejected%' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(*), 0) > 5, 'DOWN',
    sum(case when level='ERROR' AND status_message NOT LIKE '%User rejected%' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(*), 0) > 1, 'DEGRADED',
    'UP'
  ) AS state
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tool Accept / Reject Trend

panels.description: Failing tools extracted from status_message via regex. Note: total counts also live in trace metadata; this table aggregates at observation level by error message.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  failed_tool,
  count(*) AS error_count,
  count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS affected_sessions,
  toString(max(start_time)) AS last_seen
FROM (
  SELECT
    trace_id, start_time,
    arrayJoin(extractAll(coalesce(status_message, ''), 'tool error\\(s\\): ([A-Za-z]+)')) AS failed_tool
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND level='ERROR'
    AND status_message LIKE '%tool error%'
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
GROUP BY failed_tool
HAVING failed_tool != ''
ORDER BY error_count DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Failing Tools

panels.description: SRE view: which users are erroring out the most? Is the issue systemic on a user/model combination?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  count(*) AS error_count,
  count(DISTINCT t.session_id) AS affected_sessions,
  count(DISTINCT toDate(o.start_time)) AS affected_days,
  arraySlice(arrayDistinct(groupArray(coalesce(o.provided_model_name, 'unknown'))), 1, 5) AS top_models,
  arraySlice(arrayDistinct(groupArray(coalesce(substring(o.status_message, 1, 50), ''))), 1, 5) AS top_errors
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.level='ERROR'
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY error_count DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Errors by User (error distribution by user)

panels.description: Same tool within a session: count of (N+1)-th non-error calls after the N-th errored call. Note: user may have switched tasks — this is not necessarily a true retry; treat as a soft signal only.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tool_seq AS (
  SELECT
    t.session_id,
    o.start_time,
    arrayJoin(o.tool_call_names) AS tool_name,
    o.level,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.session_id, arrayJoin(o.tool_call_names) ORDER BY o.start_time) AS seq
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND length(o.tool_call_names) > 0
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  countIf(level='ERROR') AS failed,
  countIf(level != 'ERROR' AND seq > 1) AS retry_succeeded
FROM tool_seq
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tool Retry-After-Failure Success Rate

panels.description: Top tools by call count, with errors and distinct sessions visible alongside.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  arrayJoin(tool_call_names) AS tool,
  count(*) AS calls,
  count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS sessions,
  sum(case when level='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end) AS errors
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND length(tool_call_names) > 0
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY tool
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Error rate by model. Lets you compare reliability across models in one table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model,
  count(*) AS total_calls,
  sum(case when level='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end) AS errors,
  round(sum(case when level='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullIf(count(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct

panels.title: Error by Model

panels.description: How long until a new user hits their first error. Many early errors = poor onboarding experience.

targets.rawSql:
WITH user_first AS (
  SELECT
    t.user_id,
    min(t.timestamp) AS first_seen,
    minIf(o.start_time, o.level='ERROR') AS first_error
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
    AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.user_id
)
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  toString(first_seen) AS first_use,
  toString(first_error) AS first_error_at,
  case
    when first_error IS NULL then 'no error yet'
    when dateDiff('minute', first_seen, first_error) < 5 then '< 5 min (very early)'
    when dateDiff('minute', first_seen, first_error) < 30 then '< 30 min (early)'
    when dateDiff('hour', first_seen, first_error) < 24 then '< 24h'
    else '> 24h'
  end AS bucket
FROM user_first t
ORDER BY first_seen DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Time-to-First-User-Failure (onboarding signal)

panels.description: Per-minute error-burst detection over the last 60 min: BURST = error rate > 5% that minute. The go-to view for incident response.

targets.rawSql:
WITH error_events AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(start_time) AS minute,
    sum(case when level='ERROR' AND coalesce(status_message, '') NOT IN ('User rejected tool use')
              AND positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(status_message, ''), 'User rejected') = 0
              then 1 else 0 end) AS errors,
    count(*) AS total
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  GROUP BY minute
  HAVING total > 0
)
SELECT
  minute AS time,
  errors * 100.0 / total AS error_rate,
  case when errors * 100.0 / total > 5 then 'BURST' else 'OK' end AS state
FROM error_events
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 60

panels.title: Error Burst Detection (per minute)

panels.description: Distribution of trace.turn_number across the window, bucketed. Long sessions = stacked area to the right. Filter applied to skip traces without turn_number telemetry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  case
    when toInt32OrZero(metadata['turn_number']) <= 1 then '1 turn'
    when toInt32OrZero(metadata['turn_number']) <= 3 then '2-3 turns'
    when toInt32OrZero(metadata['turn_number']) <= 10 then '4-10 turns'
    else '> 10 turns'
  end AS bucket,
  count(*) AS sessions
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
  AND metadata['turn_number'] != ''
GROUP BY time, bucket
ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(avg(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])), 1) AS avg_tools,
  round(quantile(0.95)(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])), 1) AS p95_tools,
  round(max(toInt32OrZero(metadata['tool_count'])), 0) AS max_tools
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time

panels.description: Avg / p95 turn_number per session. Long sessions are debugging loops or unbroken work.

targets.rawSql:

WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Session Length (turn_number)

options.content:
## Claude Code Operations SLO Draft

| SLI | Current Measurement | Target (SLO) | Error Budget (30d) | Notes |
|-----|--------------------|--------------|--------------------|-------|
| Anthropic API upstream availability | see Row 1 | _fill in: e.g. 99.5%_ | _0.5% × total requests_ | Client cannot detect anything beyond API-side outages |
| API p95 latency | see Row 2 | _fill in: e.g. < 8000ms_ | _requests above threshold < 5%_ | Includes network — establish a baseline first |
| Tool error rate | see Row 3 | _fill in: e.g. < 2%_ | _2% × total tool calls_ | Excludes normal 'User rejected' rejections |
| Share of new users hitting first failure within 30 min | see Row 4 | _fill in: e.g. < 10%_ | — | Onboarding quality |

**Fill-in process**:
1. SRE agrees SLO targets with product / leadership.
2. Collect 2 weeks of data to establish a baseline.
3. Configure error-budget burn-rate alerts (1h burn 14.4×, 6h burn 6×, 3d burn 1×).

> **Do not display burn rate before the SLO is defined** — it only misleads viewers.

panels.title: SLO Definition Draft — burn rate below only meaningful after SRE fills this in

panels.description: Assumed SLO: 99% availability (= 1% error budget). Green zone = error rate < 1% (healthy). Line = current error rate, threshold = 1%.

targets.rawSql:
WITH window_data AS (
  SELECT
    toDate(start_time) AS day,
    countIf(level='ERROR' AND coalesce(status_message, '') NOT IN ('User rejected tool use')
            AND positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(status_message, ''), 'User rejected') = 0) AS errors,
    count(*) AS total
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT
  toDateTime(day) AS time,
  round(errors * 100.0 / nullIf(total, 0), 3) AS error_rate_pct,
  1.0 AS slo_target_pct,
  round(errors * 100.0 / nullIf(total, 0) - 1.0, 3) AS budget_burn_pct
FROM window_data
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Error Budget Burn (SLO target 99%)

panels.description: Live 30-minute window of OK vs ERROR observations, per minute. Stacked bars.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfMinute(start_time) AS time,
  countIf(level != 'ERROR') AS ok,
  countIf(level = 'ERROR') AS error
FROM observations_eff
WHERE start_time >= now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
  AND type='GENERATION'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(provided_model_name IN ($model), $model)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Last 30 Minutes Error Details

options.content:
This row determines **whether the platform team's in-house investment is paying off**. It surfaces:
- **Zombie skills / MCPs**: defined but unused — retirement candidates.
- **MCP instability signals**: timeouts, disconnects, large payloads.
- **Sub-agent usage**: which types of sub-agents are most relied on.

panels.description: Usage broken down by tool / MCP / sub-agent. calls=0 but configured = zombie (cross-check the config file).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  case
    when tool LIKE 'mcp__%' then 'MCP'
    when tool IN ('Bash','Read','Edit','Write','Glob','Grep','WebFetch','WebSearch','NotebookEdit','TodoWrite','Task','AskUserQuestion','ToolSearch') then 'Built-in'
    when tool = 'Agent' then 'Sub-agent'
    when tool LIKE 'Skill%' then 'Skill'
    else 'Other'
  end AS category,
  tool,
  count(*) AS calls,
  count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS sessions,
  sum(case when level='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end) AS errors
FROM (
  SELECT trace_id, level, arrayJoin(tool_call_names) AS tool
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
    AND length(tool_call_names) > 0
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
GROUP BY category, tool
ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Active Skills / MCP Tools (by usage frequency)

panels.description: Distribution of tool calls by category (Bash / Read / Edit / Write / Web / Agent / MCP / other).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  case
    when tool LIKE 'mcp__%' then 'MCP'
    when tool = 'Agent' then 'Sub-agent'
    when tool LIKE 'Skill%' then 'Skill'
    when tool IN ('Bash','Read','Edit','Write','Glob','Grep','WebFetch','WebSearch','NotebookEdit','TodoWrite','Task','AskUserQuestion','ToolSearch') then 'Built-in'
    else 'Other'
  end AS category,
  count(*) AS calls
FROM (
  SELECT arrayJoin(tool_call_names) AS tool
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND length(tool_call_names) > 0
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Tool Usage Share (by category)

panels.description: Aggregated by MCP server name (extracted from the mcp__<server>__<tool> prefix)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  splitByString('__', tool)[2] AS mcp_server,
  count(*) AS calls,
  sum(case when level='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end) AS errors,
  countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(status_message, ''), 'timeout') > 0
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(status_message, ''), 'disconnect') > 0
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(status_message, ''), 'connection') > 0) AS conn_issues,
  round(quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)), 0) AS p95_ms
FROM (
  SELECT trace_id, level, status_message, start_time, end_time, arrayJoin(tool_call_names) AS tool
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
    AND end_time IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
WHERE tool LIKE 'mcp__%'
GROUP BY mcp_server
ORDER BY conn_issues DESC, errors DESC

panels.title: MCP Server Health (timeout / disconnect)

panels.description: Large payloads are the primary source of MCP performance bottlenecks

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  splitByString('__', tool)[2] AS mcp_server,
  splitByString('__', tool)[3] AS tool_name,
  count(*) AS calls,
  round(avg(eff_input), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
  round(quantile(0.95)(eff_input), 0) AS p95_input_tokens,
  round(max(eff_input), 0) AS max_input_tokens
FROM (
  SELECT eff_input, arrayJoin(tool_call_names) AS tool
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)
WHERE tool LIKE 'mcp__%'
AND trace_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'Execute evaluator%')
GROUP BY mcp_server, tool_name
ORDER BY p95_input_tokens DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: MCP Tool Payload Size Distribution

panels.description: Top sub-agent usage. Low usage + high maintenance = retirement candidate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  o.name AS agent_name,
  count(*) AS invocations,
  count(DISTINCT t.session_id) AS sessions,
  sum(case when o.level='ERROR' then 1 else 0 end) AS errors,
  round(avg(dateDiff('second', o.start_time, o.end_time)), 1) AS avg_duration_sec
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND has(o.tool_call_names, 'Agent')
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY agent_name
ORDER BY invocations DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Daily request count per model. Demand-side baseline for capacity planning.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(start_time) AS time,
  coalesce(provided_model_name, 'unknown') AS model,
  count(*) AS requests
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type='GENERATION'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time, model
ORDER BY time, model

panels.description: Daily token consumption split by input / output / cache_read / cache_creation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(start_time) AS time,
  sum(eff_input) AS input,
  sum(eff_output) AS output,
  sum(eff_cache_read) AS cache_read,
  sum(eff_cache_creation) AS cache_create
FROM observations_eff

panels.title: Daily Active Users Trend

panels.description: How many users are on old versions? A high old-version share = poor upgrade adoption.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(nullIf(JSONExtractString(metadata['resourceAttributes'], 'service.version'), ''), 'unknown') AS version,
  count(DISTINCT user_id) AS users,
  count() AS traces,
  toString(max(timestamp)) AS last_seen
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY version
ORDER BY traces DESC

panels.title: Client Version Distribution

panels.description: Time from a new user's first appearance to first successful call. A hard onboarding-quality metric, and the rollout owner's core KPI.

targets.rawSql:
WITH first_event AS (
  SELECT user_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen
  FROM traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  GROUP BY user_id
),
first_success AS (
  SELECT t.user_id, min(o.start_time) AS first_ok
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND o.type='GENERATION' AND o.level != 'ERROR'
    AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.user_id
)
SELECT
  fe.user_id AS user,
  toString(fe.first_seen) AS first_seen,
  toString(fs.first_ok) AS first_success,
  case
    when fs.first_ok IS NULL then -1
    when fs.first_ok < fe.first_seen then 0
    else dateDiff('second', fe.first_seen, fs.first_ok)
  end AS time_to_first_success_sec
FROM first_event fe LEFT JOIN first_success fs ON fe.user_id = fs.user_id
ORDER BY fe.first_seen DESC
LIMIT 30
